stories.summary: As Singapore stands down most haze measures today after about two months of its worst haze since 2015, CNA reviews what worked — and the lessons for the next episode.
stories.title: Singapore's worst haze since 2015: What went right, and what are the lessons?
stories.why: Closes the chapter on the haze season that dominated Singapore's autumn, with a tougher haze law now in force.

stories.summary: DBS Q3 net profit fell 5% to S$2.81b, OCBC rose 3% to S$2.22b and UOB jumped 182% to S$1.25b off a low base; the banks are cautious into 2027 and prudent on AI-infrastructure lending.
stories.title: From AI financing to Indonesia outlook: 4 takeaways from Singapore banks' Q3 results
stories.why: The health of Singapore's three banks is a bellwether for the local economy.

stories.summary: Defence Minister Chan Chun Sing said Singapore must actively develop innovative military technology rather than wait to see how warfare evolves.
stories.title: Defence technology: Singapore must innovate, cannot wait for warfare to evolve, says Chan Chun Sing
stories.why: Signals a push for home-grown defence technology.

stories.summary: After the Nasdaq 100 plunged 6.4% on 5 Nov, wiping out about US$2.5 trillion, Singapore tech stocks were hit too; analysts urge selectivity on whether to buy the dip.
stories.title: AI stock rout: Should Singapore investors buy the dip?
stories.why: The global sell-off is hitting Singapore portfolios directly.

stories.summary: Apple cut some engineers' daily AI allowance to $200 from $300, joining Uber, Tesla and Meta in rationing premium AI as corporate budgets hold; AT&T cut some AI task costs by up to 56% by routing work to cheaper models.
stories.title: Tech Giants Ration Premium AI as Company Budgets Hold
stories.why: The first sign that the AI spending boom is meeting hard budget limits inside Big Tech itself.

stories.summary: Apple's M6 MacBook Pro went on sale on 6 Nov from $1,999; Nvidia released the open Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe speech model in 40 languages; OpenAI showed GPT-6.1 Terra for controlling a computer; Elvis Presley's heirs sued Anthropic.
stories.title: Apple's M6 MacBook Pro goes on sale as Nvidia and OpenAI ship new AI models
stories.why: A week of major AI and hardware launches landing at once, plus a high-profile AI copyright suit.

stories.summary: Zcash's NU7 upgrade activated on 6 Nov, cutting average confirmation time to 25 seconds, as developers begin work on quantum-resistant cryptography.
stories.title: Zcash's NU7 Upgrade Goes Live as Developers Launch Quantum-Resistance Effort
stories.why: A privacy coin gets faster and starts future-proofing against quantum decryption.

stories.summary: The Democrats' midterm sweep triggered a tech fire sale: the Nasdaq fell 5.5% on Thursday, its worst since April 2025, wiping about $2.5 trillion off that index alone, while Brent crude plunged below $100 on hopes the Iran war may end.
stories.title: Post-midterm tech rout wipes trillions as Nasdaq suffers worst day since April 2025
stories.why: The week's defining market event — politics, the AI trade and oil all moved at once.

stories.summary: IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva warned central banks must factor in any slowdown in AI-driven growth; the IMF says a sharp retreat in AI investment could trim global GDP by up to 1.1% by 2028.
stories.title: IMF: any slowdown in AI-driven growth is now a factor for central banks
stories.why: The AI sell-off is now a macro question, not just a stock story.

stories.summary: US stocks rebounded slightly on Friday after AI shares plunged in Asia and Europe following Thursday's dramatic Wall Street sell-off.
stories.title: Investors try to regain their footing after tech stocks tank
stories.why: The first sign of whether the rout is a correction or something bigger.

stories.summary: Traders now price in a more than 80% chance of a Fed rate hike at its 8–9 December meeting — which would follow September's first rise in three years — with Tuesday's US CPI the next big test.
stories.title: Traders price in a December Fed hike as US inflation data looms
stories.why: Rate expectations have flipped from cuts to hikes in weeks, reshaping global borrowing costs.

stories.summary: In a Truth Social post on Friday, Trump credited his actions against Iran with averting an existential threat to the region, as Washington weighs whether to resume military operations and reviews a new Iranian nuclear proposal.
stories.title: Trump claims Middle East 'would not exist' without his stopping Iran's nuclear programme
stories.why: The clearest signal yet of whether the Iran war restarts.

stories.summary: Iran's Tasnim news agency said on Saturday that two missiles struck Qeshm Island, with no official word on damage; IRNA cited witnesses saying projectiles hit the Suza area after an aircraft was heard overhead.
stories.title: Two missiles strike Iran's Qeshm Island after aircraft heard overhead
stories.why: A fresh strike in the Gulf as the US and Iran negotiate — and a test of the fragile ceasefire.

stories.summary: Zhang Shengmin, who led the corruption crackdown that sacked scores of generals, was promoted to the Politburo — the first such elevation outside a congress in three decades — leaving him as the PLA's sole military voice at the top as Xi prepares for the army's centenary in August 2027.
stories.title: Xi taps military 'hatchet man' to rebuild China's army command
stories.why: Reshapes the command of the world's largest standing army.

stories.summary: PNG and Australia agreed a new defence pact, the Pukpuk Treaty, lifting their relationship to a formal alliance with mutual defence commitments, and opening the Australian Defence Force to PNG citizens.
stories.title: Papua New Guinea and Australia agree historic Pukpuk defence pact
stories.why: A new formal alliance on Australia's northern doorstep, with direct implications for regional security.

stories.summary: NewsGuard has now identified 58 viral false claims about the US midterms across 644 confirmed instances, with 26 centred on supposed election fraud and X accounting for 65% of them.
stories.title: NewsGuard: 58 false midterm claims debunked, X hosting 65% of instances
stories.why: The most systematic count yet of how election-fraud narratives kept spreading after the vote.

stories.summary: An 11-week investigation found a Spaniard recruiting for Russia from Moscow, Vietnamese-run 'Spanish' news pages, and a Russian Telegram relay network, with a stolen-election narrative travelling from Brazil to Spain in 29 minutes ahead of the 29 November vote.
stories.title: Hybrid threats target Spain's election: Moscow recruiter, Vietnamese page farms, Russian Telegram relays
stories.why: A live case study of how foreign influence operations are assembled for a European election.

stories.summary: The Electoral Commission rejected social-media claims that a municipal official voted four times, saying she was scanned at the wrong voting district and redirected; 91% of local-election results were counted by Friday evening.
stories.title: South Africa's electoral body rejects false claims an official voted four times
stories.why: A live example of election misinformation being debunked in real time as results come in.

tldr: Singapore: As haze measures end today, CNA looks back at Singapore's worst haze since 2015 — while the three local banks report mixed Q3 results.
Technology: Big Tech is rationing premium AI as budgets hold — Apple cut some engineers' daily AI allowance from $300 to $200.
Finance: The post-midterm tech rout wiped about $2.5 trillion off the Nasdaq in a day; the IMF warns an AI-investment retreat could trim global GDP by up to 1.1% by 2028.
Defence: Trump claims the Middle East 'would not exist' without his stopping Iran's nuclear programme, as two missiles strike Iran's Qeshm Island.
Information warfare: NewsGuard has now debunked 58 false midterm claims across 644 instances, with X hosting 65% of them.
